  Trust this folder?
  ↑↓ navigate · Enter select · Esc exit

  <scratch>/kimi-fixture-trust

  Project-level MCP servers are disabled until you explicitly choose Trust. Trust starts the listed project MCP targets
  and remembers this folder.

   ❯ Trust this folder
     Enable project MCP servers. Remembered for this folder.

     Don't trust
     Exit Kimi Code. Asked again next launch.
